CharacterController.description: Makes the object the one being driven: it walks, it jumps, it climbs steps.
CharacterController.title: Character

Collider.description: Gives the object a volume the others cannot pass through.
Collider.title: Volume

Health.description: Hit points, which fall as the entity is hurt and kill it at zero.
Health.title: Health

Movement.description: Makes the entity travel on its own along one axis — a platform, a lift, a hazard.
Movement.title: Motion

RigidBody.description: Hands the object to the simulation: it falls, it slides, it gets pushed.
RigidBody.title: Physics

Trigger.description: Blocks nothing, and says so when something enters its volume or leaves it.
Trigger.title: Sensor

section.title: Components
section.addHint: Give this object something to do while the game runs
section.removeHint: Detach this component from the object
section.empty: This object does nothing while the game runs.
section.emptyHint: A component says what the object DOES, where its type says what it draws.

play.pauseHint: Freezes the game where it stands
play.startHint: Plays the scene as a game, without touching the document
play.stopHint: Throws the game away and puts the scene back as it was
